title: An extended scattering kernel formalism for multi-scale gas-surface dynamics
summary: Gas-particle interactions with non-absorbing surfaces are commonly described using the scattering-kernel formalism. In this framework, an operator $\mathbf{K}$ maps incident velocity distributions to reflected velocity distributions. The operator is self-adjoint and has norm $\lVert \mathbf{K} \rVert = 1$ in an $L^2$ space weighted by the three-dimensional Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, and must satisfy non-negativity, normalisation, and reciprocity. In standard formulations, $\mathbf{K}$ represents the aggregate effect of all gas-surface interaction mechanisms through a single operator,…
